title: Pocket Order
description: {player}, text {partner} one instruction they have to follow the second they walk in: where to stand, what to take off first, and what they are not allowed to say.

title: Two-Hour Tease
description: {player}, set a two-hour timer. Until it rings, you may only text {partner} one filthy sentence every twenty minutes. No extra replies.

title: Mirror Proof
description: {player}, send {partner} a mirror photo from the chest up. Caption it with the first thing you want their mouth to do.

title: Commute Fantasy
description: {player}, text {partner} a scene that starts in the car on the way home and ends in the hallway. Two sentences. No emoji.

title: Underwear Vote
description: {player}, send two photos of underwear options. {partner} picks. Wear that one and nothing else under your clothes until you get home.

title: Name the Room
description: {player}, text {partner} the exact room you want them in tonight and the piece of furniture you'll use first.

title: Silent Arrival
description: {player}, tell {partner} they are not allowed to speak for the first five minutes after you walk in. Hands only.

title: Song Cue
description: {player}, send {partner} a song. The second it starts playing at home, they have to take something off.

title: Lunchtime Pinch
description: {player}, at lunch, text {partner} where you would pinch, bite, or kiss them if you were under the table.

title: Permission Slip
description: {player}, text {partner}: "Ask me for permission before you touch yourself today. I'll answer yes or not yet."

title: Collar Word
description: {player}, pick a word. Every time {partner} hears or reads it today, they have to clench and think of your hands.

title: Door Open
description: {player}, tell {partner} to leave the bedroom door open and wait on the bed in whatever they want you to rip off.

title: Voice Low
description: {player}, send a voice note so quiet {partner} has to turn the volume up. Say where you want them on their knees later.

title: Three No's
description: {player}, text three things that are off-limits tonight. Everything else is fair. Make the list short on purpose.

title: Calendar Block
description: {player}, put a fake calendar event on {partner}'s phone titled something innocent. The notes field is what you actually want.

title: Ice Warning
description: {player}, tell {partner} to put a glass of ice in the freezer now. You'll use it on their skin the second you get home.

title: One Photo Rule
description: {player}, {partner} has to send one photo every hour until you walk in. Each one closer. No faces required.

title: Hands Behind
description: {player}, text {partner}: when I open the door, your hands stay behind your back until I move them.

title: Taste Preview
description: {player}, send {partner} a photo of your mouth. Caption: "This is where you're starting."

title: Edging Homework
description: {player}, tell {partner} they may touch themselves for two minutes at 6pm, then they have to stop. Proof is a timestamped text.

title: Outfit Veto
description: {player}, {partner} sends their outfit. You veto one piece. They take it off before they leave work or the shops.

title: Filthy Errand
description: {player}, give {partner} a public errand (milk, bread, whatever) and a private instruction they have to do in the carpark before they come home.

title: Name in Their Mouth
description: {player}, text {partner} they are not allowed to say your name until they're in bed. Then they have to say it every time you touch them.

title: Lights Off First
description: {player}, tell {partner} to turn every light off except one lamp. Sit where that lamp hits them. Wait.

title: Borrowed Item
description: {player}, steal one item of {partner}'s clothing today. Text a photo of you wearing it and say they can have it back on the floor.

title: Slow Walk In
description: {player}, tell {partner} that when they hear your keys, they count to twenty before they look at you. You get those twenty seconds.

title: Yes List
description: {player}, send {partner} a list of five things they are allowed to beg for tonight. They pick two. You pick the order.

title: Shower Ready
description: {player}, tell {partner} to be freshly showered and still damp when you arrive. No towel around them when the door opens.

title: Last Message
description: {player}, your last text before you walk in is one word. {partner} has to be doing that thing when you see them.

title: Hold That Thought
description: {player}, describe in four sentences what you will do with your mouth. Then text: "Hold that thought. Don't reply."
